item.title: ‘Harold and Maude’ star Bud Cort dies at 77
item.description: Bud Cort, an actor best known for starring alongside Ruth Gordon in 1971's "Harold and Maude," has died following a lengthy illness.

item.title: Richard Tillman, brother of late NFL star Pat Tillman, pleads guilty to post office arson
item.description: Richard Tillman, the younger brother of late NFL star Pat Tillman, pleaded guilty this week to federal charges for setting a California post office on fire.

item.title: Nets celebrate Lunar New Year while keeping focus before break
item.description: The Nets closed the first portion of their schedule against the Pacers as part of their annual Chinese New Year game.

item.title: Member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: The ousted member, Carrie Prejean Boller, had defended commentator Candace Owens.

item.title: Capitol rioter pardoned by Trump convicted of child sex abuse
item.description: A Florida man pardoned by President Trump after storming the U.S. Capitol in 2021 has been convicted of sex crimes involving two children.

item.title: ‘Love Is Blind’ Season 10 contestant hospitalized after pouring nail glue in eye
item.description: Season 10 of “Love Is Blind” premiered Wednesday on Netflix, and the show is already making headlines after contestant Elissa Finley was hospitalized for getting nail glue in her eye.

item.title: Jose Alvarado hits eight 3s as Knicks embarrass 76ers in 49-point victory
item.description: The Knicks enter the All-Star break winners of 11 of their last 13 games.
